svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.13.3 Location of Flashing
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Flashing over the back and top
Flashing over the head of the
Heads of window or door openings, (e)
D: top of the frame to the bottom edge of the eave.
O: horizontal eave overhang, from the wall face.
when D is more than O / 4.

svg.text: Flashing is installed in masonry and masonry
over the back and top of parapet walls, (c) over
the heads of glass block panels, (d) beneath weep
holes, and (e) over the heads of window or door
openings in exterior walls when the vertical
distance between the top of a window or door
frame and the bottom edge of the eave exceeds
one-quarter of the horizontal eave overhang.
Drawn: walls cut through, flashing thickness exaggerated, cavity tinted blue, lintel drawn as a steel angle. Sizes are illustration only.
